_meta.description: Battle Force reference table -- alternative, themed ways to build an army with their own allowed-unit lists, rank requirements, and special rules, distinct from a standard faction army.
_meta.important_correction: An earlier pass on this project nearly treated the Shadow Collective PDF's rank-requirement numbers as a generic 'standard army' rule applicable to all factions. Comparing it against the 501st Legion PDF caught this: EACH Battle Force has its OWN distinct rank requirement table, not a shared universal one. The true generic, non-Battle-Force standard-army rank requirement table was sourced for real on 2026-08-24, directly from the official Core Rulebook PDF text (not a summary) -- see data/factions.json's `standard_army_rank_requirements` field.
_meta.known_gap: This index (and therefore this file) reflects 10 battle forces found via a wiki page that may predate newer 2025/2026 additions. The Mandalorian Clans Battle Force was CONFIRMED real and shipped (June 19, 2026) via research on 2026-08-24, but deliberately not added here yet -- see docs/TODO.md, several of its units had unconfirmed classifications and one (Grogu) likely already exists in data/units.json under the Shadow Collective faction, risking a duplicate. Inferno Squad, Delta Squad, and a '212th Attack Battalion' remain unconfirmed as real Battle Forces at all. See docs/TODO.md.
_meta.verification_status: Names, faction, and theme for all 10 are confirmed via a live index page linking directly to official PDFs. 9 of 10 (501st Legion, Shadow Collective, plus Blizzard Force/Imperial Remnant/Bright Tree Village/Separatist Invasion Force/Experimental Droids/Wookiee Defenders/Echo Base Defenders, all added or updated 2026-08-24 via real research directly against each one's official PDF, with every referenced unit id cross-checked against the real data/units.json roster afterward) are fully populated with real allowed-units/rank-requirements/special-rules data. Only Tempest Force remains fully_detailed:false -- its primary PDF exceeds fetchable size limits and every alternate source tried was blocked or dead; see its own allowed_units_note for the partial secondary-source leads gathered instead.

battle_forces.special_rules: An Imperial Remnant Battle Force is part of the Galactic Empire faction. Scout Troopers and Imperial Death Troopers count as Corps units for army building; no more than 1 of each Corps-ranked unit type may be taken until at least 1 of each has been taken. This army may not include detachments. When issuing orders, a nominated Corps unit can only issue orders at range 1-2; units beyond range 2 of a friendly Corps unit gain Independent: Aim 1 or Dodge 1, and units may only use the courage value of a friendly Corps unit at range 1-2 instead of 1-3. Any non-droid Trooper unit with an upgrade-slot icon may equip an upgrade with a 'Stormtroopers only'/'Shoretroopers only'/'Scout Troopers only'/'Imperial Death Troopers only' restriction, ignoring that restriction.
battle_forces.pdf_currency_warning: The URL originally on file (static1.squarespace.com, Feb 2023) is dead (404) -- replaced 2026-08-24 with a working official Asmodee/AMG CDN URL located via search, same 2023/09 upload batch as the Blizzard Force sheet. An AMG social post (July 2024) announced updates to several Battle Force documents including this one; whether this specific file was updated in place afterward is unconfirmed (atomicmassgames.com/swlegiondocs/ returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch).

battle_forces.name: Tempest Force
battle_forces.theme_description: The Imperial Shield Control bunker defense force on Endor's forest moon (Return of the Jedi).
battle_forces.roster_source: https://starwarslegion.fandom.com/wiki/BattleForces (index page, fetched 2026-08-22), linking to each official AMG/Asmodee PDF
battle_forces.allowed_units_note: PARTIAL, secondary-source research only (2026-08-24) -- the primary PDF is too large to fetch directly (>10MB) and every alternate host/mirror tried (official AMG site, forums, a bit.ly redirect to a dead Squarespace copy) was either blocked (403) or dead (404). From cross-referenced community coverage (thefifthtrooper.com, spikeybits.com, AMG's own 'Scene to Stat' preview article), NOT a full structured list: Commander appears to be 'Major Marquand,' described as a unique AT-ST field-commander unit with the Direct: Vehicle keyword -- this unit is NOT yet in data/units.json and was not added speculatively. Other units mentioned as part of the force: Stormtroopers, Scout Troopers, Imperial Officer, (Imperial) Speeder Bikes, AT-ST. Heavy is notably expanded to allow up to 3 AT-STs (vs. the usual 2-heavy cap seen elsewhere). Special Forces requirement is 2 to 6 units. Corps requirement is 1 to 3 units (at least 1). Operative and Support allowed-units/requirements were not found in any source checked. None of this is confident enough to mark fully_detailed:true -- needs a real primary-source read (e.g. from a machine with a PDF tool that can handle the full file size) before trusting it for list validation.
battle_forces.special_rules: PARTIAL, same sourcing caveat as allowed_units_note: a Tempest Force army is part of the Galactic Empire faction. Reported special rules (not verbatim-quoted, paraphrased from secondary coverage): all vehicles in the army gain Scout 2; a unit without a friendly Commander in range and without a comms upgrade equipped removes 1 fewer suppression token during the Remove Tokens step; the army may 'rapid reinforce' one Special Forces or Support unit (exact mechanic not confirmed). Treat as a lead for the next research pass, not confirmed rules text.
battle_forces.pdf_currency_warning: Source PDF (2023/07 upload) was never successfully fetched in full during this project -- currency relative to the July 2024 '2.6' refresh is unknown.
